key_insight: Metal matrix coatings with polymer fillers can combine metallic strength and conductivity with low friction and tailored surface functionality.
engineering_relevance: Matching the metal matrix, polymer filler, and deposition route can guide multifunctional coating design for mechanical, aerospace, energy, and medical applications.
method: Classify coatings by metal matrix, polymer type, and filler morphology.
Compare electrodeposition, electroless deposition, thermal spray, cold spray, and hybrid/additive approaches.
Examine how filler characteristics and metal–polymer interfaces affect coating performance.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a comparative literature review of fabrication routes and coating properties, but reports no quantitative benchmarks or new experimental results.
watch_item: Weak metal–polymer adhesion and limited polymer thermal resistance can constrain processing and service conditions.
paper_title: Metal Matrix Composite Coatings with Polymer Fillers: Fabrication Technologies, Properties, and Applications
